name: l1000_tahoe_transform_sweep
claim: Seven per-gene normalisations of the L1000 and Tahoe delta matrices, each scored against its own mismatched-pair null. All land between rho 0.0336 and 0.0499 against a split-half noise ceiling of 0.5721, and none clears its null (best p=0.1343 for center_per_gene). Normalisation does NOT recover cross-platform agreement, so the disagreement is not a per-gene scale or offset artifact and is not fixable by representation.
